Title: Igoli's Loyalty. The acting Methuselah is also included in the draft?

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Your vampire plays Igoli's Loyalty
All other Methuselahs decline or don't have titled vampires
You have a titled vampire.

Can you elect to cast your votes in favor and get the pool?

The card says "each Methuselah" and not "each other Methuselah"

In case the answer is yes and
In case you are the only Methuselah with titled vampires.

Can you decline and burn blood once and again to increase the pool amount before electing to cast in favor?

Thanks

Igoli's Loyalty

Name: Igoli's Loyalty
[LoB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Clan: Ishtarri
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable during a referendum, before votes and ballots are cast.
Starting with your prey and going clockwise, each Methuselah with any ready titled vampires may elect to cast all of his or her vampires' votes and ballots in favor for 1 pool. Each time a Methuselah declines, this Ishtarri burns 1 blood to add 1 pool to that amount. Continue until a Methuselah accepts or this Ishtarri fails to burn a blood. When results are tallied, each vampire casting votes or ballots against this referendum burns 2 blood.
Artist: John Bridges

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
The effect may be passed many times. The acting Methuselah may accept the reward. Full details in this post:

groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/lGzforUrQR4/m/91PLHU-p02MJ

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Thanks.

And bonus questions

If someone plays a card that doesn't deny titles but deny the ability to cast votes, like closed session, Methuselahs with only tittled non-camarilla vampires are still eligible for the effect (they have titled vampires) but they are forced to decline (this is different from not having titled vampires)
So Methuselahs with titled vampires not able to cast votes are forced to decline?

Another situation. You play Igoli's Loyalty without any titled vampire. The other Methuselah plans to decline once and again to let your vampire empty. After the effect is in play and before you run out of blood, can you play an Ishtarri Kholo to get a tittle and be able to accept the effect?

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
> Coyote wrote:
> If someone plays a card that doesn't deny titles but deny the ability to cast votes, like closed session, Methuselahs with only tittled non-camarilla vampires are still eligible for the effect (they have titled vampires) but they are forced to decline (this is different from not having titled vampires)
> So Methuselahs with titled vampires not able to cast votes are forced to decline?
>
Being able to actually cast votes is not a requirement to accept. Having a title is. You can accept.

Later post in the same thread: groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/lGzforUrQR4/m/BfztiomH64YJ

> Coyote wrote:
> You play Igoli's Loyalty without any titled vampire. The other Methuselah plans to decline once and again to let your vampire empty. After the effect is in play and before you run out of blood, can you play an Ishtarri Kholo to get a tittle and be able to accept the effect?
>
Kholo titles have no restriction during which they may be played in a referendum. You can play one before votes are cast to gain a title and claim the reward from Igoli's Loyalty.

Messages.Author: Coyote
